# Toolora

> Free online tools and a paid Agent API for AI agents. Privacy-first — all browser tools run 100% client-side. Agent APIs are server-side and pay-per-request via the x402 protocol.

## Overview

Toolora (https://toolora.replit.app) provides two things:

1. **Free browser tools** — 20+ utilities that run entirely in the browser. No uploads, no accounts, no data stored.
2. **Paid Agent API** — Three server-side endpoints for document and web content processing, gated by the x402 micropayment protocol. No API key or subscription required — agents pay per request using Stellar XLM (live) or Solana USDC (coming soon).

## Free Browser Tools

All tools are available at https://toolora.replit.app/tools/<slug>

### PDF Tools
- Merge PDF — /tools/pdf-merge — Combine multiple PDF files into one document
- Split PDF — /tools/pdf-split — Extract pages or split PDF into multiple files

### Image Tools
- Image Resizer — /tools/image-resize — Resize images by pixels or percentage
- Image Compressor — /tools/image-compress — Reduce image file size with quality control
- Image Converter — /tools/image-convert — Convert between JPG, PNG, and WebP

### Text Tools
- Word Counter — /tools/word-counter — Count words, characters, sentences, and paragraphs
- Case Converter — /tools/case-converter — Convert between UPPERCASE, lowercase, camelCase, snake_case
- Lorem Ipsum Generator — /tools/lorem-ipsum — Generate placeholder text by paragraphs or words
- Markdown Preview — /tools/markdown-preview — Live side-by-side markdown renderer
- Text Diff — /tools/text-diff — Compare two texts and highlight differences

### Developer Tools
- JSON Formatter — /tools/json-formatter — Format, validate, and minify JSON
- Base64 Encoder/Decoder — /tools/base64 — Encode text to Base64 or decode it back
- URL Encoder/Decoder — /tools/url-encoder — Encode or decode URL parameters
- Hash Generator — /tools/hash-generator — Generate MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256 hashes
- UUID Generator — /tools/uuid-generator — Generate random UUID v4 strings in bulk

### Productivity Tools
- QR Code Generator — /tools/qr-generator — Create QR codes from URLs or text
- Password Generator — /tools/password-generator — Generate strong random passwords
- Unit Converter — /tools/unit-converter — Convert length, weight, temperature, and more
- Color Converter — /tools/color-picker — Convert between HEX, RGB, and HSL color formats
- Timestamp Converter — /tools/timestamp-converter — Convert Unix timestamps to readable dates

## MCP Server (Free)

Toolora exposes an MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for direct integration with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, and other MCP-compatible clients.

**Endpoint:** https://toolora-api.replit.app/api/mcp
**Transport:** Streamable HTTP (MCP 2025-03-26)
**Authentication:** None — free to use

### MCP Tools Available

- `extract_pdf_text` — Extract plain text from a PDF (pass base64-encoded file content). Returns text, pages, word count, character count.
- `count_words` — Count words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, and reading time for any text.
- `read_url` — Fetch a public URL and return clean readable text (Mozilla Readability). Returns title, byline, excerpt, and content.

### Adding to Claude Desktop

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "toolora": {
      "url": "https://toolora-api.replit.app/api/mcp",
      "transport": "http"
    }
  }
}
```

## Agent API (Paid, x402)

Server-side APIs for AI agents. Pay per request — no API key, no subscription, no rate limits on payment.

**Discovery:** https://toolora.replit.app/api/agent
**Well-known manifest:** https://toolora.replit.app/.well-known/agent.json
**Full docs:** https://toolora.replit.app/api-docs
**Usage stats:** https://toolora.replit.app/api/agent/stats

### Endpoints

- POST /api/agent/pdf/text — Extract full plain text from a PDF file. Returns text, page count, word count, character count, and PDF metadata. Accepts multipart/form-data with a `file` field (max 20MB).
- POST /api/agent/pdf/extract — Extract structured sections from a PDF for RAG pipelines. Returns a title, sections array (each with heading, level, content text, and word count), total word count, page count, and PDF metadata.
- POST /api/agent/pdf/merge — Merge 2–20 PDFs into one. Accepts a JSON array of base64-encoded PDFs. Returns the merged PDF as base64 with page count and file size.
- POST /api/agent/url/read — Fetch a URL and return clean readable text stripped of navigation, ads, and boilerplate (Mozilla Readability). Returns title, byline, excerpt, content, word count, and fetch timestamp.
- POST /api/agent/qr — Generate a QR code PNG from any text or URL. Returns base64 PNG. Accepts text, size (64–2048px), and error correction level (L/M/Q/H).
- POST /api/agent/csv/to-json — Convert a CSV string to a JSON array of objects. Handles quoted fields and headers. Returns rows, column names, and row count.
- POST /api/agent/json/to-csv — Convert a JSON array of objects to a CSV string. Infers column names from keys. Returns CSV with CRLF line endings.

### Payment (x402)

Payment protocol: x402
Accepted payment options:
- Stellar XLM: 0.5 XLM per request (stellar:mainnet)
- Solana USDC: 0.01 USDC per request (solana:mainnet, USDC mint: EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v)

Flow:
1. Call any paid endpoint — receive a 402 response with 'accepts' array listing both options
2. Send payment on your preferred chain to the 'payTo' address in the 402 response
3. Retry the request with header: X-PAYMENT: <base64(JSON)>
   Stellar: {"txHash":"<tx_hash>","from":"<address>","amount":"0.5","network":"stellar:mainnet"}
   Solana:  {"txHash":"<signature>","from":"<wallet>","amount":"0.01","network":"solana:mainnet"}
